main_topics: long COVID fatigue and brain fog
output.reason_for_conversation: support with leaving work and recovery strategies
output.summary: User with long COVID for two years decided to resign from office work due to disabling fatigue and brain fog; discussed workplace adjustments first but felt too exhausted to pursue them through HR. Assistant wrote two versions of a resignation letter, warmer on request, which the user found emotionally grounding. User then asked about pacing and recovery post-work; assistant explained pacing as matching activity to available energy to avoid post-exertional crashes. User expressed feeling calmer by the end.
